
```jsx
import { CxFormInput } from '@chassis-ui/react'
// or
import CxFormInput from '@chassis-ui/react/src/react/src/components/form/CxFormInput'
```

| Property | Description | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **className** | A string of all className you want applied to the component. | `string` \| `undefined` | - |
| **disabled** | Toggle the disabled state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **invalid** | Set component validation state to invalid. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **onChange** | Method called immediately after the `value` prop changes. | `ChangeEventHandler<HTMLInputElement>` \| `undefined` | - |
| **plainText** | Render the component styled as plain text. Removes the default form field styling and preserve the correct margin and padding. Recommend to use only along side `readonly` | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **readOnly** | Toggle the readonly state for the component. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **size** | Size the component small or large. | `'small'` \| `'large'` \| `undefined` | - |
| **type** | Specifies the type of component. | `string` \| `undefined` | text |
| **valid** | Set component validation state to valid. | `boolean` \| `undefined` | - |
| **value** | The `value` attribute of component.<br/>@controllable onChange | `string` \| `number` \| `string[]` \| `undefined` | - |
